subject: [PATCH 10/60] sched/numa: restrict NUMA migration targets to common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Posted the original patch with a clear explanation of the problem and proposed solution. The change is straightforward and addresses a potential issue in NUMA migration.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to restrict NUMA migration targets to common memory nodes, preventing migrations that can only fail due to lack of destination memory. The change modifies the `should_numa_migrate_memory` function in `kernel/sched/fair.c` to check for `N_MEMORY_COMMON` instead of `N_MEMORY`. This ensures that nodes with CPUs but no local memory are not considered as migration targets.
